# Menu Bar Reveal

> A free, open source Mac app. Press your keyboard shortcut and the hidden menu bar comes down. Press it again and it goes back up.

## Links

- [Web page](https://menubarreveal.com/): the poster.
- [Product facts](https://menubarreveal.com/index.md): what it does, the shortcut, compatibility, install, price and privacy.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/srobinson/menubar-reveal/releases/latest): the DMG and its release notes.
- [README](https://github.com/srobinson/menubar-reveal#readme): install and the first open.
